carries: the first real generation wrote twenty recipes in French against an English validator, which named none of their ingredients: the prompt is in English end to end, asks for the catalogue's exact names in the steps, ASCII ids, and 18 words a step as a hard limit
an accent in an id is normalised, not refused
the writing step prints one line per brief, so a five-minute call is not a frozen screen
GENERER.command generates recipes only; the photos are PHOTOS.command's, and a missing Draw Things no longer aborts a run
